shortDescription: Resource module for Wireless Accesspoint Configuration Create

options.name: adminStatus
options.description: Configure the access point's admin status. Set this parameter's value to "true" to enable it and "false" to disable it.

options.name: apList
options.description: Wireless Accesspoint Configuration Create's apList.

options.name: apMode
options.description: Configure the access point's mode for local/flexconnect mode, set "0"; for monitor mode, set "1"; for sniffer mode, set "4"; and for bridge/flex+bridge mode, set "5".

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: cleanAirSI24
options.description: Configure clean air status for radios that are in 2.4 Ghz band. Set this parameter's value to "true" to enable it and "false" to disable it.

options.name: cleanAirSI5
options.description: Configure clean air status for radios that are in 5 Ghz band. Set this parameter's value to "true" to enable it and "false" to disable it.

options.name: cleanAirSI6
options.description: Configure clean air status for radios that are in 6 Ghz band. Set this parameter's value to "true" to enable it and "false" to disable it.

options.name: configureAdminStatus
options.description: To change the access point's admin status, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureApMode
options.description: To change the access point's mode, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureCleanAirSI24Ghz
options.description: To change the clean air status for radios that are in 2.4 Ghz band, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureCleanAirSI5Ghz
options.description: To change the clean air status for radios that are in 5 Ghz band, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureCleanAirSI6Ghz
options.description: To change the clean air status for radios that are in 6 Ghz band, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureFailoverPriority
options.description: To change the access point's failover priority, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureHAController
options.description: To change the access point's HA controller, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureLedBrightnessLevel
options.description: To change the access point's LED brightness level, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureLedStatus
options.description: To change the access point's LED status, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: configureLocation
options.description: To change the access point's location, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: failoverPriority
options.description: Configure the acess point's failover priority for low, set "1"; for medium, set "2"; for high, set "3"; and for critical, set "4".

options.name: isAssignedSiteAsLocation
options.description: To configure the access point's location as the site assigned to the access point, set this parameter's value to "true".

options.name: ledBrightnessLevel
options.description: Configure the access point's LED brightness level by setting a value between 1 and 8.

options.name: ledStatus
options.description: Configure the access point's LED status. Set "true" to enable its status and "false" to disable it.

options.name: location
options.description: Configure the access point's location.

options.name: primaryControllerName
options.description: Configure the hostname for an access point's primary controller.

options.name: primaryIpAddress
options.description: Wireless Accesspoint Configuration Create's primaryIpAddress.

options.name: radioConfigurations
options.description: Wireless Accesspoint Configuration Create's radioConfigurations.

options.name: secondaryControllerName
options.description: Configure the hostname for an access point's secondary controller.

options.name: secondaryIpAddress
options.description: Wireless Accesspoint Configuration Create's secondaryIpAddress.

options.name: tertiaryControllerName
options.description: Configure the hostname for an access point's tertiary controller.

options.name: tertiaryIpAddress
options.description: Wireless Accesspoint Configuration Create's tertiaryIpAddress.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
